summary: Haiti’s pledges combine restoration, conservation, agriculture and mixed measures. Restoration includes 50,000 ha of afforestation/reforestation—about 13.6% of current forest cover—15,000 ha of separate reforestation, assisted-regeneration targets of 15,000 and 10,000 ha, 10,500 and 681 ha of mangrove restoration, 5,000 ha of energy forest, 151 km of roadside vegetation, and 605 ha of denuded-area reforestation. Conservation sets avoided-deforestation targets of 11,000 and 5,000 ha, manages 454 ha of tree cover, and lists coral/seagrass protection at 76 and 151 ha. Agriculture targets 20,000 ha of improved pasture, 25,000 ha of fruit trees, 30,000 ha of crop cover and 76 ha of soil-and-water conservation. Fruit trees and crop cover equal about 12.5% of current agriculture; pasture improvement equals 1.3% of grassland. Mixed actions comprise 15,000 and 3,000 ha of agroforestry reforestation, 605 ha of road-slope restoration and 454 ha of mangrove-stand management.
